errors.quote: recomendando aprender mediante experimentación gradual en lugar de herramientas complejas
errors.reason: He recommends entering gradually by building things yourself because many resources are confusing (11:11-11:22), not as an alternative to complex tools.

errors.quote: destacando la importancia de la práctica en lugar de teoría
errors.reason: He says the best way to learn is to roll up your sleeves and build, even copying existing products (11:36-11:43), but never contrasts practice with theory; he even recommends reading the lessons and articles (7:21-7:36).
